project_info.archetype: Warm Dark Artisan Bakery & Operating System

tech_stack.frontend: React, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Lucide-React / Heroicons

design_vision_and_palette.theme_type: Warm Dark (#3E2723 Dark Wood base + Terracotta & Amber/Copper accents + High-contrast crisp light text)

tailwind_classes.cta_terracotta: bg-[#C85A32] hover:bg-[#D96B43] text-[#FFFDF9] shadow-lg shadow-[#C85A32]/25 active:scale-95 transition-all
tailwind_classes.cta_amber: bg-gradient-to-r from-[#D9822B] to-[#F29A38] hover:from-[#F29A38] hover:to-[#D9822B] text-[#2B1A17] font-bold shadow-md shadow-[#D9822B]/30 transition-all

contrast_rules: Headings & primary content MUST be crisp #FFFDF9 or #E0D5CF over #3E2723 / #33201D.
Interactive buttons MUST have high-contrast text: Terracotta buttons use white text (#FFFDF9), Amber buttons use deep espresso text (#2B1A17).
Never use unreadable dark brown text on dark wood backgrounds.
Ensure all interactive hover states explicitly set readable text color.

typography_and_hierarchy.heading_font: Playfair Display, Cinzel, serif (Artisan craftsmanship & authority)
typography_and_hierarchy.body_font: Manrope, Plus Jakarta Sans, sans-serif (Clean legibility for bakers with floured hands)
typography_and_hierarchy.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, monospace (Dough calculations, weights, Baker's %)

scale.h1_hero: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight font-display text-[#FFFDF9]
scale.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight font-display text-[#FFFDF9]

above_the_fold.impact_target: Instant conversion & orientation within first 3 seconds

technical_fixes_and_routing.routing_avatar: Each avatar dialog option redirects specifically to its corresponding target page (e.g., Recipe avatar -> /ricette, Lab avatar -> /laboratorio).
technical_fixes_and_routing.initial_scroll: Global window.scrollTo(0,0) executed on route change / section transition.

universal_rules: All interactive elements MUST contain data-testid attributes for automated testing.
Touch targets must be at least 48px height on mobile views.
Header and modals MUST NOT have transparent backgrounds. Use backdrop-blur with warm dark opacity (#3E2723 with blur).
Avoid Inter/Roboto for display text; use Playfair Display for headers and Manrope for body text.
